name: maen-hanouneh-anonymous-analytics
description: Hosting-first Maen website: GitHub Actions updates frequency data and sends reports; Cloudflare Pages tracks visits; Netlify stays static hosting.

scripts.check: npm run check:github && npm run check:cloudflare && npm run check:client
scripts.check:cloudflare: node --check functions/_lib/analytics.js && node --check functions/_lib/frequency-utils.js && node --check functions/api/track-visit.js && node --check functions/api/search-feedback.js
scripts.check:github: node --check scripts/github-daily-frequency-update.mjs && node --check scripts/github-daily-analytics-report.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-seo-files.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-frequency-assets.mjs && node --check scripts/search-smoke-tests.mjs && node --check scripts/update-worldcup-2026.mjs
